data.name: DYNASTY WARRIORS 9 Special Weapon Edition
data.purchase_text: Offering a discount set that includes the game, "Hideaway Customization", and "15 Additional Weapons
data.page_content:
Offering a discount set that includes the game, "Hideaway Customization", and "12 Additional Scenarios".

■Content included
DYNASTY WARRIORS 9
Hideaway Customization Pack
"Additional Hypothetical Scenarios Set"
 - Lu Su
 - Chen Gong
 - Zhong Hui
 - Guo Jia
 - Fa Zheng
 - Cao Pi
 - Xu Shu
 - Zhou Yu
 - Xiahouji
 - Dong Bai
 - Hua Xiong
 - Yuan Shu

▼About the Hypothetical Scenarios
Play stories that differ from the main story of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 9". 
How to play the stories: After installing the stories, the corresponding officers will be selectable from "DLC" on the story selection screen. Also, by clearing the stories, each scenario will become selectable in free mode.

Note: The officers below will become playable.
Xiahouji
Dong Bai
Hua Xiong
Yuan Shu

Note: A content set that includes this DLC is also available. Please see the official site for details. (https://www.koeitecmoamerica.com/dw9/)
